personas.description: An adult woman with a clear Australian English accent, medium pitch, calm professional delivery and measured pacing, like a bank customer service representative.
personas.reference_text: Thanks for calling. I can help you check that payment and explain the next steps.

personas.description: An older adult man with an Australian English accent, low slightly gravelly voice, worried but polite delivery and occasional natural hesitation.
personas.reference_text: Hello, I am a little worried because I cannot find the transfer I made yesterday.

personas.description: An adult woman with an Australian English accent, bright midrange voice, brisk and mildly frustrated delivery, speaking clearly but quickly.
personas.reference_text: I have checked twice already, and I would really like to get this sorted out today.

conversations.scenario: A delayed bank transfer leads to a support call; test recognition of amounts and dates.

turns.text: Thanks for calling. Which payment would you like me to check?
I sent two hundred and forty dollars yesterday, but it has not arrived.
Was that Tuesday the twenty second, and did you send it before five?
Yes, around half past three. The reference was garden repairs.

conversations.scenario: A duplicate charge prompts a frustrated interruption; test overlap and merchant names.

turns.text: There are two charges from Green Valley Market, both for eighty nine dollars.
I can check whether one is still pending. Could you tell me the date?
Sorry, they are both showing as completed, on Thursday.
Thank you. I will check the transaction records before we raise a dispute.
